assessments.name: Transcription of typical child speech
assessments.description:
Early Feedback Task. Students will phonemically transcribe 10 words spoken by a typically developing child.
Will be completed in assigned Week 3 tutorials (10 am or 12 pm).

assessments.name: Phonological patterns test
assessments.description:
This pen and paper task has two parts:
Part A: Identify which phonological process/es are present in each of 10 phonemically transcribed words. 
Part B: Apply the stated phonological processes to each of 10 words, using HCE transcription
Pass = 65%
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Phonological Intervention Assessment: Part B - Oral component
assessments.description:
Interactive oral assessment (IOA). Students will individually role play therapy for their case study client and verbally explain their clinical decisions.
IOAs will be completed in Week 11 either on Tuesday 12th or Wednesday 13th May at an assigned time.

assessments.name: Phonological Intervention Assignment: Part A Written Component
assessments.description: Group assignment involving analysis of child's speech and planning intervention. The group submits a CHIRPA, management plan, and session plan for the allocated case study. All students in the group receive the same mark for Part A: Written submission
